faqs.q: Where and how are the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies used?
faqs.a: Eaton S811+/S801+ series power module assemblies are electrical power modules, not hydraulic power units, listed with voltage ratings of 2.5 kV and 5 kV. The listing carries 24 part numbers, such as MZ07A, MZ08E and MZ10B.

faqs.q: Which sizes are the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 24 part numbers, such as MZ07A, MZ07F, MZ08A, MZ08E and MZ10B, described as power module assemblies, some rated 2.5 kV, others 5 kV, and some for use with named models. The rows give no hydraulic data.

faqs.q: How should I select the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the module by the part number of the Eaton equipment it is for, and the voltage rating in the item name, 2.5 kV or 5 kV. Quote the part number and the equipment model and we confirm the match with Eaton.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies have?
faqs.a: The listing gives voltage ratings of 2.5 kV and 5 kV on some rows and none on the others, and no hydraulic pressure. Give us the Eaton equipment the module is for and we confirm the rating with Eaton.

faqs.q: What are the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the materials of the power module assemblies. Quote the part number and the equipment it is for and we confirm the build with Eaton.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, IEC or UL standard for the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies and holds no certificates. If your project needs a conformity document or test certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue. See [our guide to sizing a hydraulic pump](/blog/how-to-size-a-hydraulic-pump) for sizing the pump and motor.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies mate with?
faqs.a: Each module is for use with named Eaton equipment, so the part number must match the equipment. See [the Eaton source power modules](/p/eaton-source-power-modules) and [the SVX/SPX power modules](/p/eaton-svx-spx-series-power-modules) for the other Eaton modules.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies?
faqs.a: Check the oil level and the electrical supply of the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies against the nameplate before starting, pipe the pressure and return lines to the machine, and set the relief valve before you load the circuit. Keep the reservoir breather clear and change oil and filters on the maker's schedule.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies?
faqs.a: These modules are spare or replacement electrical parts for Eaton equipment in industrial plants, listed here with the power units. They are not hydraulic components.

faqs.q: How do the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies differ from the Eaton SVX/SPX power modules?
faqs.a: The S811+/S801+ assemblies carry 24 part numbers rated 2.5 kV and 5 kV, while [the Eaton SVX/SPX power modules](/p/eaton-svx-spx-series-power-modules) carry 21 part numbers of frequency drive modules. Both are electrical, so choose by the Eaton equipment they fit.

faqs.q: Where are the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies shipped from, and what origin and HS code apply?
faqs.a: We ship the Eaton S811+/S801+ power module assemblies from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).
